display_name: 12. 관측 통계로 정합한 밴드별 PAN 입력

controls.B1: ../8_spatial_mean_normalization N1 (softmax x HW, gamma 1, raw PAN; reused, no retraining)

training.selection: minimum validation MSE; earliest exact tie
training.initialization: experiment 4 A0 / experiment 8 N1 common initial state; no added parameters; no warm start

operation.changed_location: PAN tensor given to each band's SSA block at full, half and quarter resolution (12 blocks)
operation.unchanged: N1 SSA block (original coordinates, spatial softmax x HW, gamma 1), conv48tnum fusion, PReLU, backbone, LRPAN, decoder, loss, data
operation.guide: PAN*_b = mu_b + g_b * (PAN_stage - mu_P); g_b = min(s_b / sqrt(s_P^2 + eps^2), gain_max)
operation.pan_statistics: PAN 4x4 area average on the MS grid
operation.B2_window: 5x5 on the MS grid (20x20 PAN pixels), reflect padding
operation.B3_window: whole input per sample (diagnostic; never promoted)
operation.stage_resampling: statistic maps bilinear align_corners=False to the stage grid; stage PAN as in the original forward

checks: shared numerical sources byte-identical to N1 training snapshot
original H5 and cache hashes equal to experiment 8
A0/N1 best/latest hashes and strict load
initial state hash equal to A0/N1; no added parameters
raw-PAN path exactly equals N1 best (64x64 validation, 32x48)
zero-update gradients alive in all three SSAI stages on N1 diagnostic batches
RR/FR input-only guide summary after constants are frozen
preflight.benchmark_probe: 40 discarded Adam batches per arm; runs only after approval to train

decision.hypothesis_B2_vs_B1: FR D_s <= -0.003 and provisional QNR >= +0.005; RR PSNR >= -0.03 dB and SAM <= +0.02 deg
decision.noise_reference: two same-condition A0 runs differ by PSNR 0.036 dB and QNR 0.004
decision.repository_label_vs_A0: 개선 only if PSNR, SAM, ERGAS and provisional QNR all improve; otherwise 부분 개선 or 개선 없음
decision.path_use_check: after training, zero B2 SSA outputs; unchanged metrics mean the hypothesis was not tested
decision.B3: diagnostic only; never selected or promoted
decision.seed_repeat: seed43/44 for A0, B1, B2 only if B2 passes the hypothesis criterion; separate approval
